$comment: Suite run-lineage/v1 (v6.3 M2c): post-execution evidence through a result binding. Obligations are generated from the chain roots before execution and stay unverified (check.not_executed) until a result binding is given. Reads campaign records, execution bundles and computational-runs: input closure, acyclic run dependencies, unique product mapping, status propagation. Not supported: execution monitoring, scheduling, arbitrary step tracing, rebuilding an attempt model. Pre-release 1.1.0-dev.3 (release R2): check-context 1.1.0; the other rules and the generator are 1.0.0. check-report refuses a pre-release suite.
